in_sanskrit.name: Emisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Apsara
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Emisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Emisha is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Emi' (Goddess) and 'Sha' (Apsara). Apsaras are celestial beings, often depicted as beautiful and graceful dancers in Hindu mythology. They are believed to bring happiness and prosperity.
